factual_claims.source_evidence: Main events states: 'The bonds carry a fixed annual interest rate of 9.50%...'

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow remained positive at 14.3 million euros, providing liquidity for ongoing construction projects.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash flow statement shows Cash flows from operating activities 2025: 14,346 thousand euros (14.3M).

factual_claims.claim: The Group’s commercial real estate portfolio achieved an occupancy rate of 84% of leasable area in completed projects.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Commercial real estate section states: 'As at 31 December 2025, 84% of the total leasable area in Hepsor’s completed commercial real estate portfolio is covered by lease agreements.'

factual_claims.claim: Looking ahead, Hepsor plans to launch construction on five new development projects in 2026, including residential and commercial properties in Estonia and Latvia, further expanding its operational footprint and future revenue potential.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Future outlook section states: 'In 2026, the Group plans to launch construction of five new development projects – two residential and one commercial real estate project in Estonia, and one residential and one commercial real estate project in Latvia.'

numerical_claims.claim: Hepsor AS reported consolidated revenue of 35.4 million euros for the twelve months ended 31 December 2025, a decrease from 38.4 million euros in the previous year.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table: Revenue 2025 = 35,414 (thousand euros), 2024 = 38,397 (thousand euros)

numerical_claims.claim: The Group recorded a net profit of 1.0 million euros, compared to 2.1 million euros in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table: Net profit 2025 = 1,039 (thousand euros), 2024 = 2,134 (thousand euros)

numerical_claims.claim: Net profit attributable to the owners of the parent company remained stable at 0.4 million euros.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table: Net profit attributable to owners of parent 2025 = 399 (thousand euros), 2024 = 423 (thousand euros). Management Report presents both as '0.4 million euros'.

numerical_claims.claim: In the fourth quarter of 2025, revenue fell to 4.5 million euros from 10.5 million euros in the same period of 2024, resulting in a net loss of 0.5 million euros, whereas the Group had posted a net profit of 1.0 million euros in Q4 2024.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 4.5 million euros (Q4 2025 revenue) vs 10.5 million euros (Q4 2024 revenue); net loss of 0.5 million euros (Q4 2025) vs net profit of 1.0 million euros (Q4 2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 4,526 thousand euros (Q4 2025 revenue) vs 10,542 thousand euros (Q4 2024 revenue); -422 thousand euros (Q4 2025 net loss) vs 957 thousand euros (Q4 2024 net profit)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table: Q4 2025 Revenue = 4,526 (thousand euros), Q4 2024 Revenue = 10,542 (thousand euros); Net profit Q4 2025 = -422 (thousand euros), Q4 2024 = 957 (thousand euros). Management Report rounds net loss to '0.5 million euros' and net profit to '1.0 million euros'.

numerical_claims.claim: The decline in full-year profitability was primarily driven by a reduction in the number of apartments handed over to customers, which dropped to 141 from 194 in 2024.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'In 2025, the Group’s profitability was affected by a decrease in the number of apartments handed over to customers compared to the previous year – 141 apartments (2024: 194)'

numerical_claims.claim: Additionally, gross profit margins decreased to 15.9% from 17.6%, and marketing expenses increased to 1.3 million euros from 0.9 million euros due to intensified sales activities for a larger portfolio of projects on sale.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 15.9% (2025 gross profit margin) vs 17.6% (2024); 1.3 million euros (2025 marketing expenses) vs 0.9 million euros (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 15.9% (2025) vs 17.6% (2024); 1,334 thousand euros (2025) vs 898 thousand euros (2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key Ratios table: Gross profit margin 2025 = 15.9%, 2024 = 17.6%. Note 15: Marketing expenses 2025 = 1,334 (thousand euros), 2024 = 898 (thousand euros). Management Report confirms the reason for the increase.

numerical_claims.claim: The number of residential apartments under construction rose by 223% to 428 units at year-end, with substantial growth in Latvia where 227 homes were under construction compared to 40 in the prior year.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 428 units (2025) vs 192 units (2024) [223% increase]; 227 units (Latvia 2025) vs 40 units (Latvia 2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 428 units (2025) vs 192 units (2024); 227 units (Latvia 2025) vs 40 units (Latvia 2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Residential development projects section: 'As at 31 December 2025, the Group had 428 new homes under construction (31 December 2024: 192) representing a 223% increase... In Latvia 227 (31 December 2024: 40) homes were under construction.'

numerical_claims.claim: The Group concluded primary sales agreements for 185 homes valued at 36.1 million euros, nearly double the volume of the previous year.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 185 homes (2025) vs 109 homes (2024); 36.1 million euros (2025) vs 19.8 million euros (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 185 homes (2025) vs 109 homes (2024); 36,100 thousand euros (2025) vs 19,800 thousand euros (2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'During the reporting year, the Group concluded primary sales agreements for 185 homes... with a total value of 36.1 million euros, which is nearly twice as much as in 2024 (109 homes and 19.8 million euros)'

numerical_claims.claim: The Group also strengthened its balance sheet by increasing total equity by 23% to 27.1 million euros, largely due to non-cash contributions from non-controlling interests.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 27.1 million euros (2025) vs 22.0 million euros (2024) [23% increase]
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Balance Sheet: Total equity 2025 = 27,078 (thousand euros), 2024 = 22,010 (thousand euros). Note 11 attributes the increase primarily to 'a non-cash contribution made by the non-controlling interest to the voluntary reserve of the subsidiary Hepsor PHX5 OÜ.'

numerical_claims.claim: Total interest-bearing loan liabilities decreased to 47.7 million euros from 54.7 million euros, improving the debt ratio to 52.0% from 61.6%.
numerical_claims.candidate_value: 47.7 million euros (2025) vs 54.7 million euros (2024); 52.0% (2025 debt ratio) vs 61.6% (2024)
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Key financials table: Total interest-bearing loan liabilities 2025 = 47,747 (thousand euros), 2024 = 54,688 (thousand euros). Key Ratios table: Debt ratio 2025 = 52.0%, 2024 = 61.6%.
